description: Page organizationRolesGetList by cursor. The operation takes `cursor` and `limit` query parameters and answers { status, requestId, result: [...], limit, nextCursor }; the spec says 'Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page until it is null.' The converter's cursor detection does not recognise `nextCursor`, so the list was a single-page call. Not called live. The multi-page traversal was captured on listApiKeys, which answers the same envelope per the spec.
